node.statement: For c in U(1), conjugate-linearity gives (cU)^dagger=conj(c)U^dagger, with conj(c) in U(1). Global domain membership from lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws, applied to U and to cU (which lies in calU by node 1.1), puts U^dagger and (cU)^dagger in S_delta. Lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality with scalar conj(c) therefore gives sigma(cU)=u_delta(conj(c)U^dagger)=conj(c)u_delta(U^dagger)=conj(c)*sigma(U).
